channel.title: Bloomberg — diagnostic source feed
channel.description: Diagnostic feed grouped by acquisition connector.

item.title: Workday Posts Lukewarm Results, Blunting Recent Software Gains
item.description: Workday Inc., a maker of workplace management software, reported a measure of future sales that fell short of analysts’ projections, blunting recent momentum from Wall Street’s renewed enthusiasm for the software sector.
item.dc:creator: Brody Ford

item.title: Market Arriving To AI Discipline: Fecteau
item.description: Kyra Fecteau, Fixed Income Portfolio Manager at Wellington Management, and Andrzej Skiba, Head of BlueBay US Fixed Income at RBC Global Asset Management, join Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Real Yield." They discuss the record credit issuance, hyperscalers, and potential market pushback to the rapid growth of AI. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: AI Is 'Accelerant' For Clients, Says S&P Global CFO
item.description: Eric Aboaf, CFO of S&P Global, said that his business is to create transparency around hyperscalers for investors as the AI buildout shows no signs of slowing down. Aboaf, who was joined by Bloomberg's Nina Trentmann, said that AI is also an 'accelerant' for S&P Global on the client and revenue side of the business, as feature to help clients access key data. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Anthropic Tests New Way for Claude to Work With Robots and Scientific Lab Tools
item.description: Anthropic PBC announced a new software standard that will allow artificial intelligence assistants like Claude to work better with robots and science and manufacturing hardware.
item.dc:creator: Natalie Lung

item.title: ATF Cyber Incident Hit System With Investigative Target Data
item.description: The US Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives is investigating a cybersecurity incident involving a system containing data about the agency’s investigative targets, according to the agency.
item.dc:creator: Patrick Howell O'Neill

item.title: Hugging Face Co-Founder on Open-Source Robot, Reports of Nvidia Deal
item.description: Hugging Face unveiled MicroDuck, the company’s new open-source robot that can walk, talk, and roller-skate. Hugging Face co-founder and Chief Science Officer Thomas Wolf discusses surging demand for robotics and open-source AI, and says the company is currently selling roughly one MicroDuck every four seconds. He also declined to comment on reports that Nvidia is nearing a roughly $13 billion deal to acquire the AI startup, while saying Hugging Face regularly receives acquisition and investment interest. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Nvidia’s AI Boom, Salesforce’s Anthropic Bet | Bloomberg Tech 8/27/2026
item.description: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow breaks down Nvidia's prediction of a 70% revenue growth next fiscal year, far exceeding analyst estimates. Plus, Salesforce shares jump after giving an outlook for strong revenue expansion, and deepening its ties with Anthropic. And Hugging Face comes out with its newest robot: a duck that can walk, talk and roller-skate. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Nvidia Sees 70% Growth as AI Boom Accelerates
item.description: Nvidia’s forecast for roughly 70% revenue growth next fiscal year is changing the debate around the durability of the AI boom, according to Wealth Enhancement Group Deputy CIO Doug Huber. He explains why the question is shifting from whether AI demand is slowing to whether the industry can physically build enough compute to satisfy it, and why Nvidia’s investments in frontier AI labs could ultimately deepen demand for its technology. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: SK Hynix CEO Says Chipmaker Is Weighing Closer Ties With Kioxia
item.description: SK Hynix Inc. is exploring ways to deepen its cooperation with Japanese flash memory producer Kioxia Holdings Corp., in which the South Korean chipmaker has a significant indirect stake, Chief Executive Officer Kwak Noh-Jung said.
item.dc:creator: Yoolim Lee and Maggie Eastland

item.title: Meta Deal Quietly Resolves Claims Over 2016 Election Data, Cambridge Analytica
item.description: Nestled into Meta Platforms Inc.’s landmark settlement with US states over social media harms for kids was a seemingly unrelated agreement to resolve a privacy controversy that rocked Facebook after the 2016 presidential election.
item.dc:creator: Erik Larson

item.title: How Meta’s $18 Billion Settlement Could Change Social Media
item.description: A flood of lawsuits against social media giants claim that by engineering their platforms to be hard to resist, the companies are causing serious harm to young users.
item.dc:creator: Peter Blumberg

item.title: Nvidia Ignites AI Rally Ahead of Jackson Hole | Open Interest 8/27/2026
item.description: Get a jump start on the US trading day with Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Open Interest." Nvidia delivers a massive AI-driven forecast, lifting markets and fueling bets the AI boom still has legs. Bond markets on edge ahead of Kevin Warsh’s Jackson Hole debut. Plus, Okta CEO Todd McKinnon weighs in on AI agent security and enterprise demand. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: OpenAI, Anthropic Urge Cyber Defense Action as AI Models Improve
item.description: Artificial intelligence companies OpenAI and Anthropic PBC, along with more than 100 other tech and financial services organizations, warned that businesses and governments must do more to prepare for and defend against AI-enabled hacks.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Metz

item.title: Hugging Face Always Attracts Buyers, Co-Founder Says
item.description: Multiple reports say Nvidia Corp. is close to an agreement to buy Hugging Face for roughly $13 billion. During an interview on "Bloomberg Tech," Hugging Face co-founder Thomas Wolf declined to comment on those reports, but he did say the AI startup has always attracted interest and offers. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: JPMorgan Leads $5 Billion Debt for Volta AI Buildout
item.description: JPMorgan Chase & Co. has begun early outreach to potential lenders for a $5 billion debt package to fund Volta Infrastructure Holdings Ltd.’s buildout of AI data centers, according to people familiar with the financing.
item.dc:creator: Paula Seligson, Dina Bass and Eleanor Duncan

item.title: Hugging Face Unveils $400 Singing, Skating Duck-Like Robot
item.description: Artificial intelligence platform Hugging Face Inc. unveiled a singing $400 bipedal robot that can be taught tricks, the latest in the company’s ongoing effort to make AI and robotics more approachable to the general public.The cute robot — aptly named Microduck — takes clear inspiration from its namesake bird, except that it has only one eye. It will go on sale later this year, Hugging Face said Thursday, making it the second robot from the company.
item.dc:creator: Samantha Kelly and Natalie Lung

item.title: Nvidia in Talks to Buy AI Startup Hugging Face, Reports Say
item.description: Nvidia Corp. is nearing an agreement to acquire Hugging Face in a deal that would value the AI startup at roughly $13 billion, according to news reports.
item.dc:creator: Nick Turner and Ian King

item.title: Nvidia Sales Forecast Sends Shares on Biggest Rally Since 2025
item.description: Nvidia Corp., the chipmaker at the heart of the artificial intelligence boom, projected sales growth of 70% for the next fiscal year, sending its shares on their biggest one-day rally since April 2025.
item.dc:creator: Ian King

item.title: CrowdStrike Shares Jump Most in Over Two Years on Outlook Beat
item.description: CrowdStrike Holdings Inc.’s shares soared by the most in more than two years after the company projected revenue for the full year that exceeded analysts’ estimates, evidence that the cybersecurity industry continues to benefit from AI-fueled demand.
item.dc:creator: Jake Bleiberg

item.title: Salesforce Jumps Most Since 2020 on Outlook, Anthropic Deal
item.description: Salesforce Inc. jumped the most in six years after the software company gave an outlook for strong revenue expansion and deepened its partnership with Anthropic PBC, reassuring investors that it can compete successfully in the AI era.
item.dc:creator: Brody Ford
